steps.instruction: Melt 1/4 cup of butter in a shallow bowl.
Place 4 chicken breasts in the butter and turn to coat.
Mix 1/2 cup of Italian breadcrumbs and 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Move the chicken from the butter bowl to the breadcrumb bowl.
Roll the chicken in the breadcrumb mixture until coated.
Place the chicken in a greased pan.

steps.spoken: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle.
